theater: 蒙古高原杭愛山至河西邊境

battle.name: 沙缽略與阿波之戰
battle.theater: 蒙古高原杭愛山至河西邊境
battle.brief: 開皇三年（583）四月，突厥沙缽略可汗在白道被隋軍擊敗，控弦四十萬的東面大汗與西面小可汗阿波決裂。阿波因遣使入朝被同族視為背叛，牙帳被襲、母親被殺，遂西投達頭乞兵十萬反攻，兩可汗內戰自此打開。卡面投石機為羅馬絞盤拋石機，並不在此役現場。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場戰爭是第二突厥汗國內部的汗位內戰，交戰的兩方並非國家對國家，而是同一汗族內兩支勢力。東面主軍是攝圖，即沙缽略可汗：581年佗鉢可汗死後，他以勇力得部眾擁戴，在都斤山（今蒙古國杭愛山東支）建牙庭，控弦之士四十萬，號令草原東半部。另一方是木杆可汗之子大邏便，即阿波可汗：佗鉢可汗臨終囑阿史那庵邏立他，卻因他母親出身低微而被諸貴反對；庵邏即位後受其辱怨而讓位，攝圖遂以大邏便為小可汗，令其自領部眾，游牧於阿爾泰山之東，統轄西域諸部，並與達頭可汗、第二可汗庵邏並列為四大勢力。內戰之外，第三方是北方的隋朝：隋文帝楊堅在幽州、河東、涼州一線部署邊軍，遣上柱國趙煥帥騎兵赴汗庭分界，遣舍人長孫晟出使分化，並以衛王楊廣為行軍元帥在北線反擊；北方殘餘的齊將高寶寧一度與沙缽略聯盟，攻掠沿邊城鎮。雙方的指揮系統都不靠文書，靠可汗牙庭的分遣、叛離與重新認可；隋軍則依靠總管、刺史與行軍元帥府的分段指揮，邊州與行軍大本營之間距離以旬計，靠驛騎傳令。
countriesEn: This war was a civil war over the khanship inside the Second Turkic Khaganate, and the two sides were not state against state but two power blocs inside the same ruling clan. The eastern host was Shehui, better known as Shabilie Qaghan: after the death of Tuobo Qaghan in 581 he won the support of the tribes by his reputation for valour, set up his camp at Duqin Mountain (the eastern spur of the Khangai range in present-day Mongolia), claimed forty thousand bowmen, and gave orders over the eastern half of the steppe. The other side was Daluobian, the son of Mugong Qaghan, better known as Apo Qaghan: on his deathbed Tuobo Qaghan had told Ashina Anluo to enthrone him, but the nobles of the eastern minor khanate objected that his mother was of low birth; after Anluo took the throne he was repeatedly insulted by Daluobian, and when Anluo could not control him he handed the khanship to Shehui. Shehui then made Daluobian Apo Qaghan, letting him lead his own people, graze east of the Altai mountains and hold authority over the western regions, where he stood with Datou Qaghan and the second khan Anluo as one of the four great powers of the khaganate. Outside the civil war stood the third party, the Sui dynasty to the north: Emperor Wen Yang Jian deployed frontier troops along the line of Youzhou, Hedong and Liangzhou, sent the chancellor-general Zhao Huan with cavalry to the steppe court to fix a frontier line, sent the palace attendant Zhangsun Sheng abroad to divide the enemy, and put the Prince of Wei Yang Guang in command of the northern counter-offensive; the surviving northern Qi general Gao Baoning also allied with Shabilie for a time and raided the frontier towns. Neither side commanded through written orders: the khaganate ran on dispatch, defection and re-acknowledgement from the camp, while the Sui ran on the segmented command of governors, regional commanders and the travelling headquarters of the prince, whose distance from the frontier cities was counted in tens of days and carried by relay riders.
people: 沙缽略可汗阿史那攝圖是乙息記可汗科羅之子，581年在阿史那庵邏讓位之下取得大汗位。據《隋書》與《資治通鑑》的描述，他以勇聞於部眾，地方諸部多歸附，所居高地在杭愛山東支的都斤山。與他對立的大邏便即阿波可汗，是木杆可汗之子，因母系卑微長期被拒於汗位之外；登上小可汗之位後仍不甘心，與攝圖之間的裂痕從受辱之日起就已埋下。關鍵人物還包括西面的達頭可汗：阿波在牙帳被襲、母親被殺之後西投達頭，達頭借給他十萬騎兵，這是內戰能打成大規模戰役的前提。隋方最關鍵的一手是舍人長孫晟，他以「遠交而近攻，高強而合弱」遊說阿波與達頭，使阿波留塞上、遣使入朝，直接引爆沙缽略的怨恨；將領韋孝寬、趙煥在白道一線擊敗沙缽略，幽州總管李崇在砂城力戰至中箭而死，僕射虞慶則奉命出使，沙缽略贈馬千匹並以從妹相嫁，而北周千金公主被改封為大義公主、續做和親。587年沙缽略卒，弟處羅侯即位為莫何可汗，隨即出兵擒獲阿波獻於隋朝。
peopleEn: Shabilie Qaghan, Ashina Shehui, was the son of Yixiji Qaghan Ashina Keluo, and he took the great khanship in 581 after Ashina Anluo yielded it to him. The histories of Sui and of the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance describe him as renowned for valour among his people, with the local tribes submitting to him one after another, his seat being Duqin Mountain on the eastern spur of the Khangai range. His opposite number, Daluobian or Apo Qaghan, was the son of Mugong Qaghan, long kept out of the khanship because his mother was of low station; once installed as minor khan he remained uncontent, and the rift between him and Shehui had been open since the day he was humiliated. Another key figure was Datou Qaghan in the west: after his camp was sacked and his mother killed, Apo fled west to Datou, who lent him one hundred thousand horsemen, the precondition for this civil war to be fought on a large scale. On the Sui side the decisive hand was the palace attendant Zhangsun Sheng, who used the maxim to befriend the distant and strike the near, joining the strong to the weak, in order to persuade Apo and Datou; Apo stayed on the frontier and sent envoys to the Sui court, which instantly inflamed Shabilie's resentment. The generals Wei Xiaokuan and Zhao Huan defeated Shabilie around Baidao, the Youzhou governor Li Chong fought to the death and was struck by arrows at Shacheng, and the chancellor Yu Qingze was sent out as envoy, receiving a thousand horses from Shabilie and a marriage alliance with one of his cousins, while the late Northern Zhou princess Qianjin was re-titled as Dayi and kept in the marriage. In 587 Shabilie died, his brother Chuluohou took the throne as Mohe Qaghan, and he immediately took the field, captured Apo and presented him to the Sui court.
kits: 卡面這件投石機（Onager）是羅馬式的單人絞盤拋石機，約公元前250年前後已在羅馬軍中服役，攻城戰裡用來砸城牆、砸塔樓，是把蓄存的勢能直接換成石頭動能的投射武器。到六世紀，這門技術仍在東羅馬—拜占庭體系裡延續：同時代的君士坦丁堡圍城戰裡，拜占庭一方靠投射機與塔樓，草原帝國阿瓦爾一方靠帳篷、撞槌與覆車，兩條路正好同時擺在歐亞大陸的東西兩端。而這件兵器在583年這場戰爭裡的實際位置是：不在現場。參戰的兩支部落都是全騎兵的游牧集團，行軍可攜全部家當，攻擊方式是襲掠、驅趕與驛傳式突進，根本不解決攻城問題，因此史料裡找不到任何攻城器械的記錄。真正與它同時代、同技術譜系的器械在中原：隋軍在北線與西線戰役中已使用拋石車這類人力絞盤投射機，配合撞車、巢車、雲梯，漢人記載裡的拋石機與羅馬的 onager 在原理上一致，都是把絞盤或人力蓄下的勢能轉成石頭的動能。兵裝方面，突厥騎兵用角製複合弓、鐵制長刀與短矛，配皮甲或鐵札甲，靠馬匹速度與箭雨覆蓋；營帳用氈製、可拆可搭，這是遊牧軍隊唯一真正攜帶的攻城替代品，因為帳篷本身就能撞擊牆根。
kitsEn: The onager on the card is the Roman single-man torsion-on-a-roller-screw traction trebuchet, in service in Roman armies by about 250 BC, used in siege work to smash walls and towers and to turn stored potential energy directly into the kinetic energy of a stone. By the sixth century the technique still survived in the Eastern Roman, Byzantine system: in the sieges of Constantinople of the same age one side, Byzantium, relied on artillery and towers, while the steppe empire of the Avars relied on tent frames, battering rams and mantlets, the two approaches standing at opposite ends of Eurasia at the same moment. In this particular war of 583 the actual position of that weapon is: not on the field. Both belligerent parties were entirely mounted pastoral hosts that carried their entire households on campaign, whose way of attacking was raiding, driving off herds and striking by relay, and which had no problem of siege to solve at all; the sources accordingly record no siege engine whatsoever. The machine of the same period and the same technical family lay in China: Sui armies in the northern and western campaigns already used traction trebuchets of the type Chinese sources call a stone-throwing engine, worked together with battering rams, siege towers and scaling ladders, and the principle was the same as that of the Roman onager, converting potential energy stored by screw or manpower into the kinetic energy of a stone. On the equipment of the troops, Turkic horsemen used horn-laminated composite bows, iron-edged long knives and short spears, with leather or iron lamellar armour, relying on the speed of the horse and on the volume of the arrow shower; the tents were of felt, dismantlable and re-erectable, and those tents were the only siege substitute a pastoral army actually carried, since a tent frame itself could be driven against the foot of a wall.
tactics: 這場內戰的戰術本質是草原政治，而不是會戰。兩位可汗都沒有能力、也沒有必要去攻對方的牙庭城牆，因為汗國本來就沒有城；他們爭的是部眾、牧地與別人部眾的效忠。因此常見的動作是分兵劫掠、游騎哨探、避實擊虛，而不是排陣對攻。沙缽略的攻勢在西部受挫後轉向東南：先取涼州方向的邊郡，再深入白道、幽州一線，逼隋軍在白道與砂城消耗他的騎兵戰力。這種掠地而不據城的打法一旦遇上堅城與援兵就會失效——砂城一役，突厥騎兵久攻不克，隋將李崇退保城中，最終全軍覆沒。內戰中真正決定勝負的動作是離叛：阿波被襲之後西投達頭、乞兵十萬，達頭的加入使沙缽略腹背受敵；沙缽略則向隋朝求援，請以白道川為寄居之地，接受隋兵接應與賑給，靠外力打破僵局。隋朝這邊的戰術是「以夷制夷」：不深入草原，只在邊境打反擊，同時用使節分化，用金帛與馬匹換取停戰，最後以「磧」這片天然屏障作為國界，免得年年重劃疆線而年年開戰。
tacticsEn: The tactical nature of this civil war was steppe politics rather than set-piece battle. Neither khan had the means, or any reason, to attack the other's camp walls, because the khaganate had no cities; what they fought over was people, pasture and the loyalty of other people's followers. The usual moves were therefore disjointed raiding, mounted reconnaissance and striking where the enemy was not, not lines of battle. After his western front collapsed, Shabilie's offensive turned southeast: he took the frontier commanderies in the direction of Liangzhou first, then pushed deep along the Baidao and Youzhou line, forcing the Sui to spend his mounted strength against him at Baidao and Shacheng. This way of winning ground without holding cities failed the moment it met a fortress and relief: at Shacheng the Turkic horse could not take the ruin by storm, the Sui commander Li Chong fell back into the enclosure, and the Sui army was destroyed to the last man. The move that actually decided the civil war was defection. After his camp was sacked Apo fled west to Datou and borrowed one hundred thousand riders, and Datou's entry turned Shabilie into a man attacked on two sides; Shabilie in turn appealed to the Sui, asked to settle in the Baidao valley, and accepted Sui troops to cover him and Sui grain to feed him, so that outside help broke the deadlock. On the Sui side the method was to use one barbarian against another: no deep pursuit into the steppe, only counter-offensives on the frontier, while envoys divided the enemy and cash, silk and horses bought a truce, and finally the gravel desert itself was accepted as the border, so that the line would not have to be redrawn, and war restarted, every single year.
data: 可考證的數字集中在《資治通鑑》卷一百七十五、一百七十六與《隋書》西域傳。沙缽略在位時自報控弦之士四十萬，這是草原可汗慣用的兵源上限說法，應當視為統轄人口與潛在兵員的概數，而非實際出征的數目。583年白道之戰，隋軍大破沙缽略，記載稱其喪師千餘人；同年六月十四日，突厥攻幽州砂城，隋將李崇中流矢而死，軍潰。兩戰相隔不過兩個月，說明沙缽略的騎兵在連續作戰中消耗很快。583年涼州（武威）方向同樣失利，阿波隨軍受挫。開皇三年（583），隋曾派上柱國趙煥帥騎兵萬人、多齎帑帛赴汗庭。開皇五年（585）七月，沙缽略遣第七子庫合真特勤入朝，被封柱國、安國公，從此歲貢不絕；此前一年（584）九月，他與隋約和，贈虞慶則馬一千匹，並以從妹嫁虞慶則。583至587年之間，沙缽略被達頭所困、又被《資治通鑑》記作「阿拔」者圍困，妻子為其所掠，靠隋軍接應才擊破，隨後與隋約以磧為界。587年四月沙缽略在位七年而卒；588年十二月，莫何可汗西擊鄰國中流矢而卒，國人改立沙缽略之子雍虞閭為都藍可汗。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster in Volumes 175 and 176 of the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance and in the account of the western regions in the History of Sui. Shabilie claimed forty thousand bowmen while he reigned; this is the habitual upper-bound figure a steppe khan uses for his tributary population and potential levies, and it should be read as an order of magnitude rather than as the number actually fielded. At Baidao in 583 the Sui army broke Shabilie and the record states that he lost more than a thousand men; on the fourteenth of June of the same year the Turks attacked Shacheng in Youzhou, where the Sui commander Li Chong was struck by an arrow and died and the army broke. The two battles stand barely two months apart, which shows how quickly Shabilie's mounted strength wore down in continuous operations. The Liangzhou, modern Wuwei, front also failed in 583, and Apo was defeated with him. In 583 the Sui sent the chancellor-general Zhao Huan with ten thousand cavalry and a large amount of cash and silk to the steppe court. In the seventh month of 585 Shabilie sent his seventh son, Kuhezheng Teqin, to the Sui court, who was granted the titles of pillar of state and prince of Anguo, and from then on tribute was paid without interruption; the previous year, in the ninth month of 584, he had asked for peace with the Sui, given the chancellor Yu Qingze a thousand horses and married a younger cousin of his to him. Between 583 and 587 Shabilie was besieged by Datou and then, according to the Comprehensive Mirror, by one recorded as Aba, whose wife was carried off, and he was saved only by Sui troops coming to his relief; he then fixed the frontier with the Sui at the gravel desert. In the fourth month of 587 Shabilie died after seven years on the throne; in the twelfth month of 588 Mohe Qaghan was struck by an arrow and died while attacking a neighbouring country, and the nation raised Shabilie's son Yongyulu as Doulan Qaghan.
cause: 起因有兩層。內層是汗位繼承的裂痕：木杆可汗死後其弟佗鉢可汗即位，581年佗鉢可汗病死，遺命要立木杆之子大邏便，但東面小可汗一系以大邏便母系卑微為由反對，改立阿史那庵邏；庵邏被大邏便凌辱而不能制，於是讓位給攝圖。攝圖得位後以大邏便為阿波可汗，讓他自領部眾，實為分權之舉，卻同時保留了隨時可以爆發的隱患。四強並立的局面裡，任何一位可汗坐大，都意味著別人的牧地和部眾要重新分配。外層是隋朝北進的壓力：沙缽略先與北方殘餘的齊將高寶寧聯合，攻陷臨渝鎮，再縱兵侵擾武威、天水、安定、金城、上郡、弘化、延安諸郡；隋朝以邊軍反擊，又派長孫晟出使分化，把遠交而近攻、高強而合弱的方略貫徹下去。阿波在涼州失利後選擇留塞上、遣使入朝，這在草原外交上是與大汗分道，被沙缽略視為背叛，牙帳被襲、母親被殺，阿波只能西投達頭、乞兵十萬反攻，內戰由此全面爆發。
causeEn: There are two layers of cause. The inner one is the fissure left by inheritance: after Mugong Qaghan died his brother Tuobo Qaghan took the throne, and when Tuobo died in 581 his last words told Ashina Anluo to enthrone Daluobian, Mugong's son; but the nobles of the eastern minor khanate objected on the ground that Daluobian's mother was of low birth and raised Anluo instead. Anluo could not control the man who insulted him, and so he yielded the khanship to Shehui. Shehui then made Daluobian Apo Qaghan and let him lead his own people, a measure of division of authority that nevertheless left a fault line ready to burst. In a situation where four great powers sat side by side, any one khan growing strong meant that the pastures and followers of the others had to be redistributed. The outer layer is the pressure of the advancing Sui frontier: Shabilie first joined with Gao Baoning, the surviving general of the northern Qi, took Linrong town, and then rode out to harrow the commanderies of Wuwei, Tianshui, Anding, Jincheng, Shangjun, Honghua and Yan'an. The Sui answered with frontier counter-offensives and sent Zhangsun Sheng abroad to divide the enemy, carrying out the maxim of befriending the distant and striking the near, joining the strong to the weak. After Apo was defeated at Liangzhou he chose to stay on the frontier and send envoys to the Sui court, which in steppe diplomacy meant breaking step with the great khan; Shabilie read it as betrayal, the camp was sacked, the mother was killed, and Apo could only flee west to Datou and borrow ten thousand riders to strike back. That is the moment the civil war opened in full.
impact: 影響主要落在三層。第一是草原秩序：第二汗國從此明確分裂為東西兩部，沙缽略支系坐大東面，達頭支系與阿波支系爭奪西面與西域，最終西域的宗主權在內戰中被重新分配，直到隋煬帝大業年間西突厥分裂為十姓，格局由這場內戰定型。第二是北方邊界：隋朝用「以夷制夷」加上「約以磧為界」處理草原，把不定邊界改成有標誌的邊界，同時以和親與封爵把可汗拉入朝貢體系——沙缽略的從妹嫁給隋臣、第七子被封柱國安國公、歲貢不絕，都是這套機制的產物。第三是草原政治的成熟：可汗之間的鬥爭不再只靠武力，而是靠外交承認、靠部眾效忠的轉移、靠婚姻與贖買；沙缽略最後的處境說明這一點——他失去阿波、失去母親的支持、被達頭圍困、妻子被掠，只能靠向隋朝請援、寄居白道川、求糧賑給才活下來。對後世唐初的北方政策而言，這套經驗被直接繼承：以少量兵力與大量封賞維持草原分裂而不介入，是唐滅東突厥時的基本前提。
impactEn: The consequences fall into three layers. First, the order of the steppe: the Second Khaganate from then on divided explicitly into an eastern and a western half, Shabilie's line grew strong in the east, and the lines of Datou and of Apo fought over the west and over the western regions, so that the overlordship of those regions was redistributed inside the civil war; the shape of things was fixed by this war right down to the years of the Sui Yangdi, when the Western Turks broke into ten tribes. Second, the northern frontier: the Sui handled the steppe with the method of using one barbarian against another plus a border agreed at the gravel desert, turning an undefined frontier into a marked one, while marriage and investiture drew the khagans into a tributary order, and Shabilie's cousin married a Sui minister, his seventh son was made a pillar of state and prince of Anguo, and tribute flowed without interruption. Third, the maturity of steppe politics: struggles between khagans no longer rested on arms alone but on diplomatic recognition, on the transfer of followers' loyalty, on marriage and on purchase. Shabilie's last position shows this: having lost Apo, lost his mother's support, been besieged by Datou and had his wife carried off, he survived only by appealing to the Sui, settling in the Baidao valley and asking for grain and relief. For the northern policy of the early Tang, this experience was inherited directly: holding the steppe divided at low cost in men and high cost in gifts, without intervening, became the standing premise when the Tang destroyed the Eastern Turks.
result: 結果分兩段。583至585年，形式上是沙缽略一方佔優：他保住大汗位，在白道、涼州受挫之後轉為向隋請和，584年九月遣使求和、得虞慶則出使與馬千匹，585年七月遣第七子庫合真特勤入朝受封柱國安國公，歲貢不絕；同時他被達頭與阿波聯軍圍困，得隋軍援助才脫身，與隋約以磧為界。但兩敗俱傷的格局到587年才落定：四月沙缽略在位七年而卒，弟處羅侯即位為莫何可汗，莫何隨即出兵攻阿波，擒獲後獻於隋朝，阿波系在西部可汗的序列上中斷，由其子鞅素特勤一系的泥利可汗接替；沙缽略留下的位置則由其子雍虞閭在588年之後以都藍可汗之名坐上，但這位大汗很快在莫何戰死後的混亂中被分化。內戰的終局不是某一方的輝煌勝利，而是草原權力被重新切塊：阿波一系覆滅，達頭支系坐大西面，隋朝在東面得到一個穩定而臣服的對手，北境自583年之後到隋末再沒有大規模的突厥南侵。
resultEn: The outcome came in two stages. Between 583 and 585 Shabilie's side held the better of it in form: he kept the great khanship, and after being checked at Baidao and at Liangzhou he turned to asking the Sui for peace, sending envoys in the ninth month of 584, receiving the chancellor Yu Qingze with a thousand horses, and in the seventh month of 585 dispatching his seventh son Kuhezheng Teqin to the Sui court to be made a pillar of state and prince of Anguo, after which tribute never stopped; at the same time he was besieged by the combined forces of Datou and Apo and escaped only with Sui military help, and he fixed the frontier with the Sui at the gravel desert. But the stalemate of mutual damage was only settled in 587: in the fourth month Shabilie died after seven years on the throne, his brother Chuluohou succeeded as Mohe Qaghan, and Mohe at once marched against Apo, captured him and presented him to the Sui court, so that Apo's line was cut off from the sequence of western khagans and was succeeded by Nili Qaghan of the line of his son Yangsu Teqin. The position Shabilie left was taken by his son Yongyulu, who sat on it as Doulan Qaghan after 588, but this great khan was soon divided by the confusion that followed Mohe's death in battle. The end of the civil war was not any side's brilliant victory but a fresh cutting of steppe power: Apo's line was wiped out, Datou's line grew strong in the west, and in the east the Sui gained a stable and submissive partner, with no large-scale Turkic incursion into the northern frontier between 583 and the end of the Sui.
